title: ClaudePluginDetail
description: `POST /engines/claude/plugins`, `PATCH /engines/claude/plugins/:id`: one plugin, after the write (plan 13, B-27). `POST /engines/claude/plugins/marketplace` installs one from a declared marketplace, and `POST /engines/claude/plugins/:id/update` applies an available update to one — both B-47, and both answer the same shape. `DELETE` of the plugin resource answers `204` with no body — see `scripts/contracts-route-exceptions.json`.
